headline: Shalini Nopany submits SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE for Chambal Fertilizers
sum: Shalini Nopany filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory public disclosure requirements for the acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited.
detail: Shalini Nopany submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing is dated 18 Jun 2026 and filed through the NSE's XBRL portal. The disclosure would detail the acquisition quantum, price (if any), acquisition route (open market, bulk purchase, preferential allotment), and intended shareholding. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within one working day of the acquisition or triggering event, and may trigger open offer obligations if thresholds are breached.
